subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) One day the bad man was stealing some mangoes from the garden of his neighbour. (b) But when he did any work, he would say, "God had it done by me." (c) "Why are you stealing mangoes from my garden?" asked the owner of the garden. (d) The owner of the garden said nothing. (e) He took a stick and was waiting for the bad man till he came down from the tree. (f) 'Because God is getting it done by me," replied the bad man. (g) There was a bad man in the village. (h) The owner of the garden saw him stealing mangoes and rushed to the garden.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
